t: You're looking at the Royal Courts of Justice, a huge grey stone building in the Victorian Gothic Revival style. This is where the High Court and the Court of Appeal of England and Wales sit, and it's one of the largest courts in Europe. It was designed by George Edmund Street, an architect best known for this very building and mainly known for churches. He died before it was finished. Building went on through the 1870s, and Queen Victoria opened it in 1882. It's a Grade I listed building.
